# Brainscape

> > Brainscape is an adaptive flashcard platform using spaced repetition and the Knowledge Genome to optimize learning efficiency.

Brainscape offers both user-generated and expert-curated flashcard content across diverse subjects, from academic topics to professional certifications. The platform leverages cognitive science principles and AI to personalize study experiences.

## Key Topics

- Spaced Repetition
- Knowledge Genome
- AI Flashcards
- Brainscape Academy
- Online Learning
- Educational Technology
- NASM Certification
- Study Platform
- Adaptive Learning
- Cognitive Science
- Professional Certification
- Goal Setting
- SMART Goals
- Personal Training

## Platform Overview

- [Brainscape: The Best Flashcards App | Make Flashcards Online](https://www.brainscape.com/): Homepage for Brainscape's spaced repetition flashcard platform

## Brainscape Academy - Subject Areas

- [Fitness - Brainscape Academy](https://www.brainscape.com/academy/fitness-2/): Fitness study guides including NASM certification and training resources
